title: US postcard eras
description: Conventional eras used by US collectors to date postcards. Ranges are typical, not strict; other countries' eras differ and may get their own vocabulary.

terms.label: Pioneer
terms.description: Early cards, including exposition souvenirs, before private mailing cards were authorized.

terms.label: Private Mailing Card
terms.description: Backs printed 'Private Mailing Card'; message not allowed on the address side.

terms.label: Undivided back
terms.description: Address only on the back; messages written on the front.

terms.label: Divided back
terms.description: Back divided into message and address halves; often called the golden age.

terms.label: Linen
terms.description: Textured, linen-like paper with bright inks.
